spanish: Seis días será hecha obra, y en el día el séptimo será a ustedes santidad, shabat de shabatón a Jehová; todo el haciendo en él obra morirá.

findings.issue: Common nouns (construct + absolute) left untranslated as shabat and shabatón.
Hophal imperfect 3ms (be put to death) rendered as simple morirá, dropping passive causative stem force.
Definite qal participle (the one doing) is the gerund el haciendo, so the doer is not a clear nominal subject of the death clause.

notes: Other tokens match in number, person, and role; ustedes is the licensed 2mp of לָכֶם.
